dataset_policy: Define garment classes; apply identical quality controls; keep every eligible photograph without class caps; split full groups before any justified computational sampling. Current design uses the full cohort.

rnn_input.patches_note: 8x8 patches on RGB64 give the same 64x192 shape as columns/rows, with different neighbourhoods; other patch sizes change length and feature dimension.

selection.test: single final pass after freezing all choices

hypotheses.question: Does spatial weight sharing help?
hypotheses.contrast: Dense vs CNN, both RGB64, same train IDs, no augmentation/weights, trainable params within 10%
hypotheses.outcome: paired macro-F1 difference, per-class F1, cost; at least 3 seeds
hypotheses.limitation: report parameters and FLOPs. Dense allows 30 epochs per seed and CNN allows 10, so the difference in epoch limits should be considered when interpreting H1

hypotheses.question: Do normalization and augmentation help?
hypotheses.contrast: fixed CNN: normalization on/off and augmentation on/off, one factor at a time
hypotheses.outcome: macro-F1 difference, train/validation gap and variability

hypotheses.question: What does pretraining add?
hypotheses.contrast: identical backbone/input/preprocessing, random vs pretrained weights; frozen/head and fine-tuning reported separately
hypotheses.outcome: macro-F1, convergence epochs, train seconds; prior training cost disclosed

hypotheses.question: How do inverse-frequency loss weights affect minority classes?
hypotheses.contrast: same CNN and all natural-prevalence train products, unweighted vs train-derived class weights

hypotheses.question: What does balancing the training sampler change?
hypotheses.contrast: natural train shuffle vs balanced class sampler, same eligible products, same optimizer update budget; unchanged natural validation/test
hypotheses.outcome: macro-F1 and minority recall; actual group/image budget differences reported
hypotheses.limitation: Optional training strategy ablation, not a new filtering rule or a balanced evaluation dataset

hypotheses.question: Does sequence representation disadvantage recurrence?
hypotheses.contrast: same 64x64 RGB image IDs: columns vs rows; patches secondary due changed sequence/feature dimensions
hypotheses.outcome: macro-F1, length, input dimension, parameters, time and memory

population_sensitivity.design: Evaluate on the observed distribution of the selected garment types after quality controls. Publish class counts by split, macro-F1 and accuracy; do not reweight balanced predictions to claim a natural test.
population_sensitivity.limitations: Group-wise proportions are approximate in images; category selection and historical exposure constrain inference to this cohort, not the entire catalog.

class_review.current_decision: Include every product type in Garment Upper body, Garment Lower body and Garment Full body: 26 catalog labels, not a hand-picked subset.
class_review.top_review: Top is included under the same family rule as every other type. Two previously inspected examples are registered on the training side; semantic overlap is analyzed, not used to remove the label.
scope_review_criteria: minimum independent product groups and split feasibility
systematic review of overlap/label noise, not only sample count

controlled_training_budget.checkpoint: best validation macro_F1 among epochs reached before stopping
controlled_training_budget.pretraining_contrast: same fixed LR grid [0.001,0.0001] allowed for both initializations; report total search cost
controlled_training_budget.changes: amend protocol before fitting neural models if hardware cannot support budget

cnn_amendment.budget: 110 minutes per CNN phase (h1, then batchnorm), with at most 10 epochs per seed and one discarded pilot epoch
cnn_amendment.reason: The H1 CPU pilot measured 166.7 seconds per epoch. Ten epochs per seed give a conservative estimate of 104.2 minutes for three seeds.
cnn_amendment.photos: no automatic cap; stop for explicit review if the estimate exceeds the budget

sequence_amendment.budget: 5 h for phase cells (RNN, LSTM, GRU; 9 fits), 2 h for attention and 2 h for rows (3 fits each); one discarded pilot epoch per variant
sequence_amendment.size: same hidden state 128 for every cell; not parameter-matched with Dense/CNN (reported as references)
sequence_amendment.photos: no automatic cap; stop for explicit review if the estimate exceeds the budget

generative_minimum.split_policy: inherit product splits; audit exact text duplicates; separate textual manifest if exclusions required; no visual split changes
generative_minimum.budget_scope: separate didactic generation experiment; does not replace three-seed visual protocol
